prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn quota_ledger(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse limit;account:delta records. Limit is a canonical unsigned decimal in 0..10000000; accounts use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*; deltas are canonical signed decimals in -10000000..10000000. Apply in order from zero and reject any balance below zero or above limit. Return all touched account balances sorted by account.
Visible example: 10;a:4,b:3,a:-1 returns a=3,b=3.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::BTreeMap;fn key(s:&str)->bool{let p:Vec<_>=s.split('-').collect();!s.is_empty()&&s.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&p.iter().all(|x|!x.is_empty()&&x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))}fn can(s:&str)->Option<i64>{let v:i64=s.parse().ok()?;if v.to_string()!=s||v < -10000000||v>10000000{None}else{Some(v)}}pub fn quota_ledger(s:&str)->Option<String>{let p:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if p.len()!=2||p[1].is_empty(){return None}let limit=can(p[0])?;if limit<0{return None}let mut d=BTreeMap::new();for r in p[1].split(','){let(k,x)=r.split_once(':')?;if !key(k){return None}let v=d.get(k).copied().unwrap_or(0i64).checked_add(can(x)?)?;if v<0||v>limit{return None}d.insert(k,v);}Some(d.into_iter().map(|x|x.0.to_string()+"="+&x.1.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
